environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 100 in COUNT mode for baseline telemetry, (2) a custom rule group 'inventory-api-input-constraints' at priority 200 that applies a regex match condition on the query string with pattern '^[a-zA-Z0-9_=%&\-\.\s]*$' — action BLOCK if the regex does NOT match (using NOT_MATCH on RegexPatternSet applied to QueryString), (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet at priority 300 in COUNT mode only (not blocking). The ECS task role has no network egress except to the VPC endpoint for CloudWatch Logs. Container runs with read-only root filesystem; /tmp is a tmpfs mount.

config.waf_rule_2: Custom rule group 'inventory-api-input-constraints', priority 200, action: BLOCK. Condition: QueryString does NOT match RegexPatternSet /^[a-zA-Z0-9_=%&\-\.\s]*$/
config.ecs_task_network: egress only to com.amazonaws.us-east-1.logs VPC endpoint
